title: Temps Not As Hot Wednesday - NewsBreak
text:
By Braden Petry NonStop Local Weather Anchor ,
12 hours ago Red Flag Warning for Kittitas Valley until 9 PM Wednesday. A dry west-northwest flow will persist across the region through Friday before another trough moves into British Columbia on Saturday. As the trough approaches, it will strengthen the cross-Cascade pressure gradient, bringing gustier winds to Central Washington and creating breezy conditions along with elevated fire weather concerns. The trough will also bring a slight cooling trend over the weekend. Once it moves through, a weak upper-level ridge is expected to build over the area Monday and Tuesday, promoting more stable weather conditions. Read full article
